## Load data and packages 
```{r}
library(sfarrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tigris)
library(tidyterra)
library(tmap)
library(janitor)
library(paletteer)
library(patchwork)
library(showtext)
library(kableExtra)


birds_joined <- st_read_parquet(here('data', 'data_processed', 'birds_joined.parquet'))

source(here("R", "point_blue_theme.R"))
source(here("R", "rich_gini.R"))
showtext_auto(enable = TRUE)

```

## Observations by year

```{r}
# Where the data are, when, habitat and Gap? 

ggplot(birds_joined, aes(x = year_collected, y = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE)))+
  geom_col()+
  theme_linedraw()+
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'Year', 
       title = 'Observations by Year')+
  point_blue_theme()
```

Observations by year with density and area search/ point count 

```{r}

birds_joined %>%
  group_by(year_collected, survey_type) %>%
  summarise(observations = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year_collected,
    y = observations,
    color = survey_type,
    fill = survey_type,
    group = survey_type
  )) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.5, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(point_blue, point_green)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(point_blue, point_green)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    label = scales::comma,
    limits = c(0, NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Avian Knowledge Network Bird Observations Over Time",
    subtitle = "Point count data is densely clustered 1995-2005",
    y = "Number of observations",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  point_blue_theme()


```


## Observations by gap status

```{r}
birds_joined %>% 
  group_by(gap_sts, survey_type) %>% 
  summarise(observations = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = gap_sts, y = observations, color = survey_type,
    fill = survey_type,
    group = survey_type))+
  geom_col(position = "dodge")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(point_blue, point_green)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(point_blue, point_green)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    label = scales::comma) +
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'GAP Status', 
       title = 'Observations by GAP Status') +
  point_blue_theme() +
  annotate("segment", x = 6, xend = 6, y = 20000, yend = 170000) +
  annotate(geom = "text",
          x = 6, 
          y = 250000, 
          label = "observations \nin open water", 
          family = "lib_frank",
          size = 5
          )

```

## Observations by habitat type

```{r}
habitat_obs_area <- birds_joined %>% 
  filter(survey_type == "Area Search") %>% 
  group_by(habitat_type, survey_type) %>% 
  summarise(observations = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(habitat_type = reorder(habitat_type, observations)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = observations, y = habitat_type)) +
  geom_col(fill = point_blue) +
  scale_x_continuous(label = scales::comma, expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 800000)) +
  point_blue_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'Habitat Type', 
       title = 'Observations by Habitat in Area Searches')


habitat_obs_point <- birds_joined %>% 
  filter(survey_type == "Point Count") %>% 
  group_by(habitat_type, survey_type) %>% 
  summarise(observations = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(habitat_type = reorder(habitat_type, observations)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = observations, y = habitat_type)) +
  geom_col(fill = point_blue) +
  scale_x_continuous(label = scales::comma, expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 800000)) +
  point_blue_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'Habitat Type', 
       title = 'Observations by Habitat in Point Count')

habitat_obs_area / habitat_obs_point
```

## Observations by county 
```{r}
counties <- tigris::counties() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(statefp == '06') %>% 
  mutate(area = (aland+awater)* 1e-6) %>% 
  select(namelsad, area) %>% 
  st_transform(crs(birds_joined))

total_observations <- birds_joined %>% 
  select(observation_count) 
  
county_obs <- total_observations %>%
  st_join(counties %>% select(namelsad, area)) %>%  # join county info onto points
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(namelsad) %>%
  summarize(
    total_observations = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    area = first(area)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_observations = replace_na(total_observations, 0),
    density = total_observations / area
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(density))

county_obs %>%
  rename(
    "County Name" = namelsad,
    "Total Observations" = total_observations,
    "Area (km²)" = area,
    "Density (#/km²)" = density
  ) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = point_light_blue) %>% 
  save_kable(here::here('Outputs', 'figures', "county_density_table.png"), zoom = 4)
```

```{r}
yearly_biodiv <- birds_joined %>% 
  gini_simpson() 

range(yearly_biodiv$rich_gini, na.rm = TRUE)

yearly_biodiv <- yearly_biodiv %>% 
  group_by(year_collected) %>% 
  summarize(rich_gini)
```
